messages:
Morgan (PM): quick sync — can we re-evaluate RICE scores for the Q3 candidate list? customers bumped impact, eng estimates changed. want a consistent recalibration before the planning meeting.
Devon (Eng): where's the latest sheet? link pls.
Morgan (PM): pasting the current snapshot below. reach = weekly MAU affected, impact 1-3, confidence 0-100, effort = person-weeks.
```
Initiative | Reach | Impact | Confidence | Effort
AI adaptive routing | 20000 | 3 | 80 | 10
Adaptive batching | 8000 | 2 | 60 | 6
Dedicated pricing UI | 5000 | 3 | 50 | 12
Eval platform infra | 12000 | 2 | 70 | 8
```
Riley (PM): my gut — the standard R*I/E formula is skewing toward huge-reach infra work. small, low-effort high-reach features lose out.
Sana (Research): agree. Proposal: normalize reach with sqrt, take log(effort) for denominator, and use geometric mean for R and I to reduce domination by one axis. also clip confidence below 40 -> treat as 0.5x.
Liam (Design): design effort routinely undercounted — for customer-visible UX we should add a +20% design buffer to effort or separately score cross-functional cost.
Devon (Eng): sequencing note: Dedicated pricing UI depends on infra quotas. we should split initiatives into "infra work" + "customer-facing" and score separately so can ship partial value.
Morgan (PM): good call. also we need a repeatable normalization so PMs don't hand-tune scores. can we agree on a standard transform?
Sana (Research): I'll run a quick sensitivity sim tonight. suggested transforms: reach' = sqrt(reach), effort' = log1p(effort), score = (R'^0.5 * I'^0.5 * C) / effort'. That keeps impact vs reach balanced.
Riley (PM): sounds reasonable. how do we keep confidence meaningful? customers with strong qualitative evidence should get +10 pts. low data -> penalize more.
Devon (Eng): engineering confidence should include deploy risk + cross-team coord. maybe add a binary "blocked-by-external" flag that reduces effective confidence.
Morgan (PM): decision proposal: adopt Sana's transforms, cap confidence at 80 (no one gets 100), add design buffer for visible UX, split dependent initiatives. Morgan will recompute and publish.
Liam (Design): 👍 please tag any initiative with UX-impact so I can review estimates.
Riley (PM): I'll surface the top 8 customer asks for the triage (which likely shift impact up).
Sana (Research): I'll attach the sensitivity delta table to the sheet (RICE_vs_zscore_comparison). gives expected rank changes.
ops-bot: Reminder: planning deadline is EOD Friday. calendar invite placeholder created for an 11:00am triage tomorrow.
Morgan (PM): 11:00 AM works for me. I'll publish updated sheet + short agenda by 9:00. Agenda = recompute, reconcile cross-team splits, finalize top 6 for planning.
Devon (Eng): bringing a quick breakdown of infra deps.
Riley (PM): will prep customer-impact notes.
Morgan (PM): thanks — if anyone wants to pre-check a specific initiative, drop a note here or DM. 👍
